Day 3: On our final morning, we were welcomed at ITECH. After a campus visit, we discussed International Credit Mobilities and Erasmus Mundus projects. We would like to take this opportunity to thank Gustavo Insarraulde from the Université Jean Monnet in Saint Etienne for sharing his experience in this field with us.

We would also like to thank the Auvergne Rhône-Alpes Region and the Erasmus+ France Agency for their support and contributions, as well as all the partners for the wonderful synergy and energy created!
